result:
## Cross-family review: chunk-D1-1 (`d5db8ff`)

Verified independently: path before/after equality on every routed composition, residual greps, judge AST hole probes, `local_backend` bootstrap shape, suite green (197), no `R` renames in the build commit.

---

### Findings

```
- severity: medium
  category: silent-green
  section: tests/test_layout_paths.py:314-320
  claim: shell wiring proves paths.sh exports usable layout roots
  evidence: |
    Test 3a only runs:
      test -n "$PHASE5_SCRIPTS_ROOT" && test -n "$BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL"
      && test -f "$PHASE5_SCRIPTS_ROOT/envelope-manifest.py"
    PHASE5 is value-checked indirectly (file must exist). BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL
    is only non-empty. EVIDENCE_ROOT is never asserted to be "".
    Counterexample that still exits 0:
      EVIDENCE_ROOT="wrong"
      BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL="also-wrong"
      PHASE5_SCRIPTS_ROOT="phase-5/scripts"
    fire-design-review.sh residual scan only forbids the literals
    "phase-4.5/build-evidence" and "phase-5/scripts" in non-comment lines
    (test_layout_paths.py:332-333); a wrong BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL value that
    is not those strings still passes. Chunk 1's actual paths.sh is correct
    (BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL="phase-4.5/build-evidence", EVIDENCE_ROOT=""), but
    the gate does not pin that.
  recommended_change: |
    Assert exact shell values after source, matching §2.4 defaults:
      test "$EVIDENCE_ROOT" = ""
      test "$BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL" = "phase-4.5/build-evidence"
      test "$PHASE5_SCRIPTS_ROOT" = "phase-5/scripts"
    Planner re-lock required.

- severity: medium
  category: silent-green
  section: tests/test_layout_paths.py:239-265
  claim: test 1 pins every path root to today's layout
  evidence: |
    test_path_root_constants_have_expected_values_and_exist value-asserts
    the seven §2.1 roots only. BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL (config.py:88), which
    carries every --help / banner prose site (sprint-loop.py:1121-1123,
    config.py:333-335, chunk_close_banner.py:52), is never value-asserted.
    Wrong BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL="other/path" leaves tests 1-3 green (definitions
    exempt in config.py; residual scan skips constant Assigns) while changing
    --help bytes. Today's value is correct
    (os.path.join("", "phase-4.5", "build-evidence") == "phase-4.5/build-evidence");
    the gate does not lock it.
  recommended_change: |
    Add assert _require(config, "BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL") == os.path.join(
        "phase-4.5", "build-evidence"
    ). Planner re-lock.

- severity: medium
  category: silent-green
  section: tests/test_layout_paths.py:168-204 (_bare_segment_constants_in_path_context)
  claim: residual scan sees both path-construction idioms used in this repo
  evidence: |
    Probed _residual_phase_literals against synthetic sites. FLAG on
    os.path.join bare segments, joined "phase-1/scripts" literals, static
    f-strings, pathlib Path/PurePath Div. MISS (no hit) on all of:
      "%s/scripts" % ("phase-1",)
      "{}/scripts".format("phase-1")
      f"{a}{b}/scripts" with a="phase-", b="1"
      "/".join(["phase-1", "scripts"])
      os.sep.join([root, "phase-1", "scripts"])
      seg = "phase-1"; os.path.join(root, seg, "scripts")
      "phase-" + "1" + "/scripts"
      PARTS = ["phase-1", "scripts"]; os.path.join(root, *PARTS)
    Also MISS on phase_path(root, "evidence", "phase-4.5", "build-evidence")
    bare args (Call to phase_path, not join/Div). The live tree does not
    currently use the MISS idioms for layout paths, so this chunk is not
    green via a hole; a later "route" that only renames the composition
    form can reintroduce hardcodes without turning the judge red.
  recommended_change: |
    Either broaden the scan (string-value walk for forbidden substrings is
    already done for joined forms; extend bare-segment context to any Call
    whose callee name endswith path/join, or forbid bare _BARE_SEGMENT
    constants outside labels via a denylist of kwarg names), or document
    the hole as an accepted residual and add a follow-on judge chunk.
    Do not treat the current scan as complete anti-miss coverage.

- severity: medium
  category: sequencing
  section: tools/sprint_loop/config.py:88 vs tools/sprint_loop/paths.sh:13-14
  claim: Python and shell BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL are mirrors of the same name
  evidence: |
    Python (config.py:88):
      BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL = os.path.join(EVIDENCE_ROOT, "phase-4.5", "build-evidence")
    so after EVIDENCE_ROOT → "evidence" it becomes
    "evidence/phase-4.5/build-evidence" automatically.
    Shell (paths.sh:13-14):
      EVIDENCE_ROOT=""
      BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL="phase-4.5/build-evidence"  # comment: unchanged by Chunk 2
    composed as
      RUN_DIR="${EVIDENCE_ROOT:+${EVIDENCE_ROOT}/}${BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL}/${RUN_ID}"
    Both are correct today (RUN_DIR and help both equal
    "phase-4.5/build-evidence/..."). They are not the same derivation.
    Chunk 2 hazard: if the executor "syncs" shell BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL to the
    Python post-flip value while leaving EVIDENCE_ROOT="evidence", RUN_DIR
    becomes "evidence/evidence/phase-4.5/build-evidence/<id>".
    Spec §2.4 already says shell BUILD is unchanged by Chunk 2; the Python
    derivation quietly disagrees with that story.
  recommended_change: |
    Before chunk-D1-2: either (a) make Python BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL a pure
    segment constant os.path.join("phase-4.5", "build-evidence") with help
    text composed via phase_path/EVIDENCE_ROOT:+ style, matching shell, or
    (b) put an explicit Chunk-2 rule in CHUNK-2-SPEC: flip EVIDENCE_ROOT
    only; never rewrite shell BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL; never join EVIDENCE_ROOT
    onto a BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL that already contains it.

- severity: high
  category: sequencing
  section: planning/layout-refactor/CHUNK-2-SPEC.md:71-75
  claim: Chunk 2 flips constant values only (relative segments)
  evidence: |
    CHUNK-1-SPEC §2.1 forward invariant forbids baking framework_root into
    module-level constants. CHUNK-2-SPEC §2.2 still drafts:
      SCRIPTS_ROOT → os.path.join(framework_root, "tools", "phase-1-scripts")
      LOCKS_ROOT → os.path.join(framework_root, "tools", "phase-1-locks")
      EVIDENCE_CODE_ROOT → os.path.join(framework_root, "tools", "phase-3.2-evidence")
    That is a NameError at import (framework_root is not module-level) or,
    if somehow bound, absolute paths that break phase_path's
    join(framework_root, PHASE_ROOTS[kind], *parts) into doubled roots.
    CHUNK-1-SPEC §2.5.1 already gates chunk-D1-2 on fixing this plus
    locked-test-guard.py / lock.py self-relative defaults. Confirmed still
    unfixed in the committed CHUNK-2-SPEC. Not introduced by d5db8ff; still
    a hard stop before Chunk 2 opens.
  recommended_change: |
    Amend CHUNK-2-SPEC §2.2 to relative segments only, e.g.
    SCRIPTS_ROOT = os.path.join("tools", "phase-1-scripts"), and add the
    two self-relative DEFAULT_LOCKS_DIR sites named in CHUNK-1-SPEC §2.5.1.
    Do not open chunk-D1-2 until that lands.

- severity: low
  category: factual
  section: tools/sprint_loop/config.py:216-220, backends.py:125-127
  claim: evidence paths are fully routed through roots (no residual phase literals)
  evidence: |
    default_evidence_dir and LocalBackend fallback still pass the segment
    literals "phase-4.5" and "build-evidence" as *parts into phase_path:
      phase_path(self.framework_root, "evidence", "phase-4.5", "build-evidence", run_id)
    Before: os.path.join(fw, "phase-4.5", "build-evidence", run_id)
    After:  os.path.join(fw, "", "phase-4.5", "build-evidence", run_id)
            == os.path.join(fw, "phase-4.5", "build-evidence", run_id)  (verified equal)
    Behaviour is a no-op today. The phase-4.5/build-evidence spelling is
    still duplicated at every evidence call site and inside
    BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL; Chunk 2's value flip of EVIDENCE_ROOT alone relies
    on those call-site segments staying. Spec §2.2 explicitly requires
    segment-preserving form, so this is not a Chunk-1 miss, but it is
    residual hardcoding the residual scan cannot see (phase_path Call args).
  recommended_change: |
    Optional cleanup in Chunk 2: route evidence dirs as
    os.path.join(framework_root, BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL, run_id) with
    BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL kept as the pure relative segment (see prior
    finding), so the segment lives in one assignment.

- severity: low
  category: correctness
  section: phase-3.2/evidence/local_backend.py:51-58,98-101,400
  claim: bootstrap self-root is only for sys.path; composed paths use --framework-root
  evidence: |
    _SELF_RELATIVE_FRAMEWORK_ROOT is assigned at :51-53 and loaded only to
    build _TOOLS_DIR (:55). AST walk shows no other Load. run_verify_green
    uses phase_path(framework_root, "scripts", "verify-green.py") with the
    function arg (:101). tool_versions uses
    os.path.join(SCRIPTS_ROOT, "verify-green.py") (:400) — relative segment
    only, identical to prior "phase-1/scripts/verify-green.py".
    three dirname calls from phase-3.2/evidence/ and from the Chunk-2 target
    tools/phase-3.2-evidence/ both yield repo root (verified). Import is
    module-level and unguarded. On this 3.9.6 interpreter, --help still
    dies on pre-existing `dict | None` at :189 (TypeError); stderr has no
    ModuleNotFoundError for sprint_loop. Bootstrap is correct.
  recommended_change: none for Chunk 1

- severity: nit
  category: spec-deviation
  section: tools/sign_chunk_token.py:6,135
  claim: §2.3 authorizes rewording fenced docstrings to name <TOKENS_ROOT>
  evidence: |
    chunk_sequence_gate.py:9 was reworded to <TOKENS_ROOT>/...
    sign_chunk_token.py:6 and :135 still say phase-4.5/tokens/...
    Spec marks rewording preferred but not gated; judge skips docstrings.
    Zero behaviour change either way.
  recommended_change: optional docstring reword in a docs pass; not blocking.

- severity: nit
  category: factual
  section: d5db8ff commit message vs phase-1/locks/tests/test_layout_paths.py.lock.json
  claim: build commit ran locked judge sha256 82035450...
  evidence: |
    Commit body cites 82035450...; lock file and current tests/test_layout_paths.py
    are 233eee9d... (post-build da68fd0 judge fix for unsatisfiable exit-0).
    Executor did not edit the judge in d5db8ff (git show --name-only d5db8ff
    has no tests/test_layout_paths.py). Factual drift in the commit message
    only; lock matches HEAD.
  recommended_change: none required for close; note in ledger if desired.
```

---

### What is solid (brief)

- Every §2.2 filesystem composition I checked is string-identical to the pre-`d5db8ff` form under empty roots (`ALL_OK` on locks, scripts, evidence-code, build-evidence, verify-green relative).
- Empty-root f-string trap is avoided: `BUILD_EVIDENCE_REL` and shell `${EVIDENCE_ROOT:+…}` do not emit a leading slash; help/CHECKLIST bytes match parent.
- No directory renames in `d5db8ff`; suite 197 green; residual scan clean on all `ROUTED_PY_FILES`.
- Shell source is REPO_ROOT-anchored; `RUN_DIR` / envelope-manifest composition matches §2.4.

---

`VERDICT: ACCEPT-WITH-NITS`
